heading: Research, bridges & computational mechanics
philosophy: My work brings together computational mechanics and bridge engineering. I study how structural health monitoring, topology optimization, and artificial intelligence can support the assessment and design of engineering structures.

My research spans robust design under uncertain loading, auxetic and mechanical metamaterials, vibration control, and impact mechanics. At CSIR-CRRI, I contribute to bridge research, structural audits, condition assessment, and projects combining experimental, numerical, and AI-based approaches.

I am a Scientist C at CSIR-Central Road Research Institute (Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India), New Delhi, and an Assistant Professor at the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR). I welcome conversations with students, researchers, and industry partners working on related engineering problems.
